fixed.explanation: `_validate_tolerance` rejects only negative tolerances in its timedelta, integer and float branches, so zero is already accepted. The error text said "must be positive", which wrongly implies zero is invalid. All three messages now say "tolerance must be non-negative". Tests that match the old text need the same change.

query.intent: The as-of merge validation of the tolerance argument (in _get_merge_keys / _validate_tolerance style checks for timedelta, integer and float keys) raises a MergeError whose message says tolerance must be positive; the message should say it must be non-negative, while the check (reject only values < 0) stays unchanged.
query.symptom: Passing a negative tolerance to merge_asof raises a MergeError saying the tolerance must be positive, which wrongly implies zero is invalid, though zero is accepted.

history.analysis: _AsOfMerge._validate_tolerance in pandas/core/reshape/merge.py raises MergeError("tolerance must be positive") in three branches (timedelta, integer, float). The checks reject only values below zero, so only the message needs changing, to say "non-negative". Existing tests (test_valid_tolerance, test_tolerance_negative_one_nanosecond) match the old message and will need updating too.
